texts.facts: This application is filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. to quash the proceedings in Crime No.251 of 2020, pending on the file of the Jammikunta Town Police Station, Karimnagar District against petitioner Nos.1 to 4. The offences alleged against them are under Sections 270 and 273 of IPC. 2.
